items.title: browser-use/video-use
items.summary: video-use 是一款基于 Claude Code 的开源视频编辑代理，通过 ElevenLabs Scribe 转录音频和可视化合成层，以仅 12KB 文本加少量图片的低 Token 消耗替代传统的高成本逐帧分析方案。该工具支持自动切除填充词、色彩分级、字幕嵌入及动画叠加，并能通过 self-evaluation 循环确保剪辑质量。
items.why_now: Browser Use刚发布video-use，用代码代理实现AI视频剪辑。
items.summary_en: Video-use is a 100% open-source tool that enables coding agents like Claude Code to edit raw video footage through natural language commands. It utilizes ElevenLabs Scribe for precise audio transcription and self-evaluates rendered outputs to cut filler words, auto-grade color, and burn subtitles without processing visual frames directly.

items.title: 秋声 | 袁进辉新公司冲港股IPO，成立不到三年
items.summary: 硅基流动于2023年8月成立，主要提供基于自研推理引擎和异构算力编排的AI推理基础设施服务，支持170+模型部署。尽管2025年注册用户突破1000万、日均token吞吐量增长12倍且付费客户激增292倍，但其当年收入仅5533万元，因算力租赁成本高昂导致毛利率为-24%，净亏损达3.45亿元。公司在两年半内完成七轮融资，估值从2.8亿元飙升至77.4亿元，并于近期以18C身份向港交所递交上市申请。
items.why_now: Q2末硅基流动提交港股IPO，估值两年半飙至77亿。
items.why_now_en: Q2 IPO bid signals burning cash.
items.summary_en: SiliconFlow, founded by Yuan Jinhui in August 2023, filed for a Hong Kong IPO under Rule 18C with a post-money valuation of approximately 7.74 billion RMB following seven funding rounds. The company operates as China's largest independent token supplier by volume, aggregating heterogeneous computing power via its self-developed inference engine to serve over 10 million registered users and 716,000 paying customers. Despite a 292-fold increase in paying clients and 12x growth in daily token throughput between late 2024 and early 2026, SiliconFlow reported a negative gross margin of -24% in 2025, with sales costs reaching 124% of its 55.33 million RMB revenue due to high compute leasing expenses.

items.title: Jamesob's guide to running SOTA LLMs locally
items.summary: 该指南介绍了在本地运行最先进大语言模型（LLM）的方法，核心在于利用量化技术降低显存需求并提升推理速度。通过与云端方案对比，它强调了本地部署在数据隐私和延迟控制方面的优势，同时提供了具体的硬件配置建议以实现高效运行。
items.summary_en: Jamesob’s GitHub guide provides a comprehensive resource for running state-of-the-art large language models locally, leveraging open-source tools to enable high-performance inference on consumer hardware. The project emphasizes practical implementation strategies that allow users to access advanced AI capabilities without relying on cloud-based services or expensive API costs. By detailing specific configurations and model optimizations, it serves as a definitive reference for developers seeking to deploy SOTA LLMs in private, local environments.

items.title: JuliusBrussee/caveman
items.summary: JuliusBrussee/caveman 是一款支持 Claude Code、Cursor 等 30+ 代理的插件，通过压缩输出语言风格使令牌消耗减少约 75%，同时保持 100% 的技术准确性和约 3 倍的速度提升。该工具提供 lite、full、ultra 及 wenyan 等多种模式，并配套 caveman-code 完整代理方案，在相同任务下比 Codex 节省约 2 倍令牌。
items.why_now: 刚发布可装30+代理的插件，即时削减75%Token成本。
items.summary_en: JuliusBrussee’s `caveman` is a Claude Code skill that reduces output tokens by approximately 75% while maintaining 100% technical accuracy through compressed, "caveman-style" responses. Compatible with over 30 agents including Codex and Cursor, it offers multiple compression levels (lite, full, ultra, wenyan) and installs via a simple shell script or PowerShell command.

items.title: santifer/career-ops
items.summary: Career-Ops 是一个基于 Claude Code 构建的开源 AI 求职系统，支持 14 种技能模式及批量处理功能。该工具通过结构化评分和 ATS 优化简历生成，帮助开发者自动评估职位匹配度并生成个性化 PDF。作者利用该系统评估了 740+ 个职位列表，生成了 100+ 份定制简历，并最终成功获得 Head of Applied AI 职位。
items.why_now: 开源项目发布，助力独立开发者高效求职。
items.summary_en: Career-Ops is an open-source, AI-powered job search system built on Claude Code that automates candidate evaluation and application management through a terminal-based dashboard. It utilizes 14 skill modes and batch processing to evaluate job listings using a structured A-F scoring system while generating ATS-optimized PDFs and cover letters. The creator successfully used the tool to assess over 740 job listings and generate more than 100 personalized CVs to secure a Head of Applied AI role.

items.title: affaan-m/ECC
items.summary: ECC是一个跨平台智能体工作流优化系统，支持Claude Code、Codex、Cursor等12+种语言生态，拥有211.9K+星标及230+贡献者。其v2.0.0版本引入了261项技能、记忆持久化机制及并行化处理能力，旨在通过Token优化和自动学习提升生产级智能体的性能与安全。
items.why_now: ECC v2.0于2026年6月发布，支持多AI代理工具。
items.summary_en: ECC (Agent Harness Performance Optimization System) is a production-ready framework supporting Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI agent harnesses, boasting over 211.9K GitHub stars and 230+ contributors. It provides a comprehensive suite of features including token optimization, memory persistence, security scanning via AgentShield, and cross-harness orchestration. The latest version, ECC v2.0.0, introduces a stable operator system with 261 skills, while ECC Pro offers a hosted GitHub App for private repositories at $19 per seat per month.

items.title: HKUDS/Vibe-Trading
items.summary: Vibe-Trading 是 HKUDS 推出的个人交易智能体，支持通过单命令赋能全面交易能力，并集成 WebSocket、Telegram、Slack 等 16 种内置消息适配器进行会话运行时管理。项目近期优化了因子加速与安全运行时边界，采用 NumPy 快速路径提升性能，并引入 PreTradeAdvisoryInterface 实现无死锁的实盘建议安全拦截。此外，新增 Trading 212 只读连接器及 Windows/Gemini 兼容性修复，强化了跨平台部署与沙箱隔离机制。
items.why_now: 2026年7月2日发布新版API与安全加固，独立开发者应关注其模块化进展。
items.summary_en: Vibe-Trading is a personal trading agent developed by HKUDS that enables comprehensive market capabilities through a single command interface. The platform supports 16 built-in messaging adapters for real-time research delivery and includes security features like sandboxed backtesting and broker-agnostic pre-trade advisory interfaces. Recent updates have optimized factor acceleration using NumPy fast paths and expanded connector support to include read-only access for Trading 212.

items.title: AIEWF Daily Dispatch: The great loops debate and the state of AI engineering
items.summary: 在AI Engineer World’s Fair的辩论中，Ralph Loop创建者Geoffrey Huntley主张循环已具备可行性并倡导软件工厂模式，而HumanLayer的Dex Horthy与Subroutine的Greg Pstrucha则质疑其经济可持续性及工程纪律滞后。与此同时，Anthropic通过发布内部模型Claude Tag展示了早期软件工厂的实践，该模型被描述为比Claude更具委托性、异步性和主动性，旨在通过多角色责任委派提升开发效率。
items.why_now: Anthropic上周发布Claude Tag，展示AI工程软件工厂落地实践。
items.why_now_en: Anthropic's Claude Tag launched last week.
items.summary_en: At the AI Engineer World’s Fair, a debate highlighted the tension between autonomous software factories and traditional engineering, with advocates like Geoffrey Huntley promoting the inevitability of loops while skeptics warn against hype outpacing discipline. Concurrently, Anthropic showcased its internal model, Claude Tag, described as more delegated, asynchronous, and proactive than standard Claude, signaling an early practical implementation of software factory concepts where teams delegate responsibilities to agents rather than replacing them entirely.

items.title: Open Source AI Gap Map
items.summary: Current AI于2025年2月在巴黎AI行动峰会上成立为非营利组织，已承诺4亿美元资金，并发布了开源AI差距地图（Gap Map）。该地图深度收录了来自228个组织的421款产品，包括266个软件工具、85个模型、50个数据集和20个硬件项目，涵盖14个类别及三层技术栈。底层数据以MIT许可证通过GitHub发布，包含1,184个YAML文件及相关脚本，便于通过Datasette Lite等工具进行探索和分析。
items.why_now: 非营利组织2月成立，Gap Map日前发布。
items.why_now_en: Feb 2025 launch signals open AI shift
items.summary_en: Current AI, a non-profit backed by $400 million in committed capital, launched the Gap Map v0.1 to index 421 open-source AI products across software, models, datasets, and hardware. The project’s underlying data, comprising 1,184 YAML files and tracking over 16,000 GitHub repositories, is available under an MIT license for public exploration.

items.title: Fable's judgement
items.summary: 通过提示让 Claude Code 自主判断任务复杂度并调用 Sonnet 或 Haiku 等低算力子代理处理编码工作，可将主要模型的精力保留给需要判断力的审查与综合环节。这种策略有效减少了昂贵的 Fable 令牌消耗，在保障开发效率的同时显著降低了成本。
items.why_now: Anthropic Fable涨价在即，独立开发者需立即优化成本。
items.summary_en: Users can optimize Fable token efficiency by instructing Claude Code to autonomously delegate coding tasks to lower-power subagents, such as Sonnet for implementation and Haiku for minor edits. This strategy preserves high-cost model allowances for judgment-heavy work like design and auditing while significantly reducing overall expenditure.

items.title: Quoting Josh W. Comeau
items.summary: Josh W. Comeau 表示其最新课程 Whimsical Animations 销量仅为同类课程 launches 的三分之一，且所有课程收入下降超过 50%。这一趋势主要归因于 LLM 带来的双重冲击：开发者因职业焦虑减少学习投入，且倾向于使用提供个性化辅导的大语言模型替代付费课程。
items.why_now: AI致课程销量腰斩，开发者教育市场窗口期剧变
items.summary_en: Josh W. Comeau reports that his course sales have dropped significantly, with revenue falling by over 50%, primarily due to the rise of LLMs. This decline is attributed to developers' hesitation to invest in paid learning amid job uncertainty and the availability of free, personalized tutoring from AI models.

items.title: AI-Assisted AuthZ Review: Reading Permission Boundaries in Ory Kratos
items.summary: 本文以开源身份管理服务器 Ory Kratos 为审计目标，利用 AI 辅助审查技术生成了 H1 至 H5 五项关于权限边界的具体假设。作者通过代码溯源验证了这些假设，最终确认所有嫌疑均被“击杀”，证明该方案能有效避免误报并聚焦于真实的安全设计逻辑。
items.why_now: 2026年赏金计划收紧，凸显AI辅助AuthZ审查的时效价值。
items.summary_en: The article outlines an AI-assisted authorization review methodology for the open-source identity management server Ory Kratos, focusing on generating and disproving hypotheses rather than hunting for bugs. Five potential vulnerabilities—ranging from missing admin API checks to token reuse—were systematically tested and dismissed as intentional design features, such as relying on network-level boundaries for administration. This approach demonstrates how AI can efficiently filter out false positives to produce a "kill table" of invalidated suspicions, ensuring human reviewers only investigate surviving, credible risks.

items.title: Memory Sidecar v3.5.1: Operational Hardening for Agent-Agnostic Memory
items.summary: Memory Sidecar v3.5.1 通过引入带校验和的 WAL、分片锁管理器及 AES-256-GCM 加密，解决了数据损坏、并发竞争及安全漏洞问题。性能方面，序列化从 JSON 切换至 MessagePack 使载荷减半，在 50 个并发代理的压力测试中，尾部延迟降低 35%，读取 p99 延迟减少 40%。部署推荐通过 hermes-memory-installer 进行，该版本强制 TLS 1.3 并将底层存储迁移至 RocksDB。
items.why_now: Memory Sidecar v3.5.1发布，解决并发数据损坏与性能瓶颈。
items.summary_en: Memory Sidecar v3.5.1 enhances operational reliability through a revamped write-ahead log with checksums and a sharded lock manager, reducing tail latency by 35% for 50 concurrent agents. Performance optimizations, including switching to MessagePack serialization and an improved LRU eviction policy, cut p99 read latency by 40%. Security is strengthened with mandatory TLS 1.3 and AES-256-GCM at-rest encryption, deployable via the `hermes-memory-installer`.

items.title: Google Autocomplete Is a Free Keyword Research API
items.summary: 该文章介绍利用 Google Autocomplete 的免费公开端点（client=firefox）进行关键词挖掘，无需 API Key 即可获取长尾查询建议。通过 A-Z 后缀、疑问词前缀等策略对种子词进行扩展，单次请求可批量生成 200 至 400 个唯一关键词建议。由于该接口不提供搜索量数据，建议结合 Google Trends 验证趋势，也可使用 Apify 上的付费服务自动化处理。
items.why_now: 无需API Key即可调用Google自动补全接口，适合低成本挖掘长尾关键词。
items.summary_en: Google’s public autocomplete endpoint allows developers to generate 200–400 long-tail keyword suggestions per seed by applying A-Z, question, and preposition modifiers via fan-out techniques. To maintain access, users must pace requests at 100–150ms intervals, handle rate limits gracefully, and deduplicate results, while pairing this data with Google Trends for volume insights. Alternatively, the workflow can be automated using pay-per-use Apify actors that integrate both keyword expansion and trend analysis without requiring API keys.

items.title: hasaneyldrm/exercises-dataset
items.summary: 该数据集基于ExerciseDB v1，包含1,324个健身动作的结构化元数据及英、西、意、土、俄、中六语指令翻译。它提供开发者设置向导和交互式浏览器，支持按类别、器械和目标肌肉群筛选，适用于构建健身应用后端或机器学习项目。需注意原始缩略图和视频媒体因版权原因未包含在内，仅保留媒体ID供授权调用。
items.why_now: ExerciseDB竞品关服，数据遭弃用，独立开发者需警惕版权风险。
items.summary_en: The `hasaneyldrm/exercises-dataset` provides a structured collection of 1,324 fitness exercises, including metadata and step-by-step instructions translated into six languages. While it excludes media assets due to copyright claims, it retains original ExerciseDB media IDs for reference. The repository also features a developer setup wizard and an interactive HTML browser for filtering and exploring the dataset locally.

items.title: agentskills/agentskills
items.summary: Agent Skills 是由 Anthropic 开发的开源标准，通过包含 SKILL.md 的轻量级文件夹结构，为 AI 智能体提供可扩展的专业知识与工作流。该机制采用渐进式披露策略，仅在任务匹配时加载完整指令，从而在保持极小上下文占用的同时赋予智能体领域专长和可重复执行的能力。
items.why_now: Anthropic发布Agent Skills开源标准，构建跨平台AI智能体技能生态。
items.summary_en: Agent Skills is an open standard developed by Anthropic that allows AI agents to extend their capabilities by loading specialized knowledge and workflows from portable, version-controlled folders. The system utilizes a hierarchical structure centered on a `SKILL.md` file to manage metadata and instructions, enabling agents to progressively discover, activate, and execute tasks while minimizing context footprint. Licensed under Apache 2.0 for code and CC-BY-4.0 for documentation, the format supports cross-product reuse across various agentic clients.

items.title: openai/codex-plugin-cc
items.summary: 该插件允许用户通过 Claude Code 中的 `/codex:review` 和 `/codex:adversarial-review` 命令，直接调用 OpenAI Codex 进行代码审查或任务委派。支持后台运行及分支对比，旨在将 Codex 集成至现有开发工作流以提升代码质量与效率。
items.why_now: OpenAI发布Codex插件，让开发者可直接在Claude Code中调用Codex进行代码审查。
items.summary_en: The openai/codex-plugin-cc integrates OpenAI’s Codex into Claude Code via slash commands like `/codex:review` and `/codex:adversarial-review` for code analysis and task delegation. Users must have Node.js 18.18+ and a ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key to install the plugin through the marketplace and configure authentication. The tool enables read-only reviews and background job management, allowing developers to challenge design assumptions or investigate bugs directly within their existing workflow.

items.title: usestrix/strix
items.summary: Strix 是一款开源 AI 渗透测试工具，支持 gpt-5.4 等大语言模型，通过多智能体协作自动发现并修复应用程序漏洞。它具备完整的渗透测试工具包，包括动态代码执行、浏览器利用及 SAST/DAST 能力，能生成带有工作概念验证（PoC）的准确结果。该工具原生集成 GitHub Actions 和 CI/CD 流水线，可实现 PR 阶段的自动化安全扫描与一键自动修复补丁。
items.why_now: Strix新增GitHub Actions集成，实现PR阶段自动漏洞扫描与拦截。
items.why_now_en: CI/CD integration enables pre-production security scans.
items.summary_en: Strix is an open-source AI penetration testing tool that uses autonomous multi-agent orchestration to dynamically identify, validate, and fix application vulnerabilities via working proof-of-concepts. It integrates seamlessly with CI/CD pipelines and offers a developer-first CLI, providing actionable remediation guidance and auto-generated patches to eliminate false positives common in static analysis.

items.title: Alibaba to ban Claude Code in workplace over alleged backdoor risks, source says
items.summary: 阿里巴巴因涉嫌后门安全风险，计划在公司内部禁止使用 Anthropic 的 Claude Code 编程助手。该决定源于路透社报道的消息来源，反映了企业对引入外部大模型代码工具时数据安全问题的担忧。
items.summary_en: Alibaba plans to ban the use of Anthropic's Claude Code in its workplace environment due to alleged security concerns regarding potential backdoor risks. This decision highlights growing enterprise scrutiny over third-party AI development tools and their integration into corporate infrastructure.

items.title: actions/checkout
items.summary: GitHub Actions官方仓库actions/checkout已升级至v7版本，默认拒绝处理fork的pull request代码以防止“pwn request”安全风险，并迁移至ESM格式以支持新版@actions/*包。该动作通过持久化认证令牌到$RUNNER_TEMP目录下的独立文件来增强凭证安全性，且需Actions Runner v2.327.1及以上版本以兼容node24运行时。
items.summary_en: Actions/checkout v7 introduces safer fork pull request handling by refusing to check out fork code by default in `pull_request_target` or `workflow_run` triggers to prevent "pwn request" vulnerabilities. The action has migrated to ESM and updated dependencies, requiring the node24 runtime and Actions Runner v2.327.1 or later. Users must explicitly set `allow-unsafe-pr-checkout: true` to opt in to the previous behavior.

items.title: langflow-ai/langflow
items.summary: Langflow 是一款支持 Python 3.10–3.14 的开源平台，提供可视化构建器、多智能体编排及 MCP Server 部署能力，可集成主流 LLM 和向量数据库。用户可通过 `uv pip install langflow` 快速安装并访问 localhost:7860 进行开发测试。该平台支持将工作流导出为 API 或 JSON，具备企业级安全特性及 LangSmith 等可观测性集成。
items.summary_en: Langflow is an open-source platform for building and deploying AI-powered agents and workflows, featuring a visual builder, multi-agent orchestration, and support for major LLMs and vector databases. It allows users to deploy flows as APIs or MCP servers and offers easy installation via Python, Docker, or its dedicated desktop application.

items.title: pytorch/pytorch
items.summary: PyTorch是一个提供GPU加速张量计算和基于磁带自动微分系统的动态神经网络的Python包。其核心组件包括torch张量库、autograd自动微分、jit编译栈以及nn神经网络模块，旨在替代NumPy并利用GPU提升科学计算速度。作为深度集成Python的研究平台，它支持动态网络构建和灵活扩展，显著优于传统的静态计算图框架。
items.summary_en: PyTorch is a Python package providing GPU-accelerated tensor computation comparable to NumPy and dynamic neural networks via a tape-based autograd system. Its core capabilities include high-speed tensor operations, flexible imperative programming, and deep integration with standard Python libraries like SciPy and Cython. The framework supports various hardware accelerations, including NVIDIA CUDA, AMD ROCm, and Intel GPU, serving as both a numerical computing library and a deep learning research platform.

items.title: 氪星晚报｜西贝餐饮集团退出小女当家；FF洛杉矶总部人去楼空？公司回应：不实
items.summary: 德银预测Meta通过对外出售AI算力，到2027年可新增90亿至300亿美元收入；阿里云旗下AI原生数据库Databridge Agent将于2026年8月1日正式商业化收费。此外，xTool发布集成四种打印能力的O1 UV打印机，GitHub Copilot接入月之暗面开源模型Kimi K2.7，法拉第未来否认洛杉矶总部搬空传闻。
items.summary_en: Deutsche Bank estimates Meta could generate up to $30 billion in new AI-related revenue by 2007 by selling excess computing capacity, while Alibaba Cloud will commercialize its Databridge Agent service starting August 1. Additionally, GitHub Copilot has integrated Moonshot AI’s open-source Kimi K2.7 model, and xTool launched the O1 UV printer, which integrates four printing technologies into a single device.

items.title: 鹏鼎控股：拟定增募资不超96亿元，用于庆鼎AI服务器和高速光模块高密度互连积层板项目
items.summary: 鹏鼎控股拟通过定向增发募集资金不超过96亿元，重点投入庆鼎电子的AI服务器及高速光模块高密度互连积层板项目。该举措旨在强化公司在高端PCB领域的产能布局，以适配人工智能基础设施对高速互联组件日益增长的需求。
items.summary_en: Pengding Holdings plans to raise up to 9.6 billion yuan through a private placement to fund high-density interconnect laminated board projects for Qinding's AI servers and high-speed optical modules. The capital will specifically support production capabilities for these advanced electronic components.

items.title: Show HN: Durable AI agents without the workflow engine
items.summary: 该文章介绍了一种无需工作流引擎即可构建持久化 AI 智能体的方法，其核心技术主张在于简化架构并降低实现复杂度。通过移除传统的工作流中间件，开发者能够更直接地管理智能体的状态与生命周期，从而提升开发效率。
items.summary_en: Durable enables the creation of AI agents without relying on traditional workflow engines, offering a streamlined alternative for agent development. The approach focuses on simplifying the architecture to reduce complexity while maintaining robust functionality for autonomous tasks.

items.title: Show HN: Auto-continue Claude Fable 5 the second your 5-hour limit lifts
items.summary: 该工具名为CCLimitPing，旨在当Claude API的5小时速率限制解除时自动继续执行任务。它通过GitHub仓库wavever/CCLimitPing提供实现，解决了长时间运行任务在限额重置后的无缝衔接问题。
items.summary_en: The GitHub project CCLimitPing enables users to automatically resume Claude Fable 5 conversations immediately after the five-hour usage limit resets. This tool functions by continuously monitoring the API status to detect when the limit lifts, allowing for uninterrupted workflow without manual intervention.

items.title: 对话乐享科技 CEO 郭人杰：具身智能有希望诞生苹果级别的公司，我们有机会成为这家丨多样性公司
items.summary: 乐享科技累计融资超10亿元，旗下品牌元点Zeroth已发布M1、W1等具身智能终端并突破3万订单。公司依托郭人杰在扫地机器人领域的经验，聚焦家庭场景，通过集成小脑运动能力与多模态交互技术，致力于提供具备主动性与情感连接的全自动智能硬件。
items.summary_en: Leshang Technology, founded by ex-Dreame executive Gu Renjie, has secured over 1 billion RMB in Pre-A funding and achieved 30,000 orders for its home embodied AI robots, including the Disney-licensed W1. The company focuses on the consumer market with products like the M1 and Jupiter under its brand Zeroth, leveraging mature motion control and multimodal interaction technologies to enable full-house autonomy and emotional connectivity.

items.title: Show HN: Kontext – Move an AI chat's full context to another AI in one click
items.summary: Kontext 是一款开源工具，允许用户通过一键操作将当前 AI 对话的完整上下文无缝迁移至另一个 AI 平台。该工具旨在解决不同大语言模型间上下文隔离的问题，提升多模型工作流的连贯性与效率。
items.summary_en: Kontext is an open-source tool that enables users to transfer the complete context of an AI chat session to another AI interface with a single click. It simplifies workflow continuity by eliminating manual copy-pasting between different platforms.

items.title: Show HN: Sharing LLM Artifacts with your team
items.summary: Dropway 是一款支持拖拽、CLI 及 MCP 集成的 LLM 产物共享工具，旨在解决非技术人员在 Cloudflare 等平台部署 HTML/markdown 文件时的复杂性。它提供基于邮件白名单或组织的细粒度访问控制，具备不可变部署和自动版本回滚功能，并兼容 Claude、Codex 等主流 LLM 工作流。

items.title: 生数科技正式发布Vidu S1实时交互模型
items.summary: 生数科技正式发布Vidu S1实时交互模型，该模型支持实时视频通话和语音控制视频走向。其性能参数包括540P（960x540）高清分辨率、25FPS帧率（最高支持42FPS）。用户可基于真人、动漫或萌宠等初始形象及个性化音色，快速创建专属交互角色。
items.summary_en: Shengshu Technology has released the Vidu S1 real-time interactive video generation model, which supports real-time video calls and voice-controlled narrative direction. The model delivers 540P resolution at up to 42 FPS and enables the rapid creation of custom interactive characters based on diverse initial images and personalized voice tones.

items.title: Show HN: DoodleMeme – Animated Memes from Your Hand Drawn Doodles (No GenAI)
items.summary: DoodleMeme 是一款无需登录且免费的动画工具，利用非生成式 AI 的动画管线将手绘涂鸦转化为动态表情包。该工具支持桌面端和移动端，通过特定的动画处理流程实现角色动作生成。
items.summary_en: DoodleMeme is a free, no-login-required tool that converts hand-drawn characters into animated memes using a traditional animation pipeline rather than generative AI. The application supports both desktop and mobile platforms.

items.title: Show HN: Reading Assistant Physical Books Meta RayBans
items.summary: 该工具结合Meta Ray-Bans智能眼镜与Claude Sonnet模型，通过语音指令“Hey Lumos”实现对实体书PDF内容的即时问答。用户只需上传书籍PDF并在阅读中提问，助手即可检索书中信息并语音回复，有效避免了切换设备导致的注意力分散。目前项目处于极端测试阶段，旨在提供无缝的阅读辅助体验。
items.summary_en: The Reading Assistant integrates with Meta Ray-Ban smart glasses to enable voice-activated queries via the "Lumos" command while users read physical books. By uploading a PDF of the text, the system allows readers to ask questions and receive immediate explanations from an AI assistant without breaking their focus or switching devices.

items.title: Show HN: Theta-spec harness agnostic config surface
items.summary: Theta-spec 是一个开源项目，旨在为不同的大语言模型提供统一且与模型无关的配置表面。该项目通过 GitHub 上的 tamarillo-ai/theta-spec 仓库发布，实现了跨模型配置的标准化与解耦。
items.summary_en: Theta-spec is an open-source tool that provides a specification-agnostic configuration surface for LLMs, allowing users to define and manage model parameters through a unified interface. By leveraging the Theta specification standard, it enables seamless integration across different language models without requiring code changes for each provider.

items.title: Show HN: Mlx-serve – LLM inference server for Apple Silicon, written in Zig
items.summary: Mlx-serve 是一个专为 Apple Silicon 设计的 LLM 推理服务器，采用 Zig 语言编写。该项目旨在优化在苹果芯片上的大语言模型部署与运行效率。
items.summary_en: Mlx-serve is an LLM inference server for Apple Silicon developed in Zig. It provides optimized performance specifically tailored for running large language models on Apple hardware.

items.title: Show HN: How clanker are you? A reverse Turing test
items.summary: 该工具利用Llama3.1、Deepseek v3和Qwen3等开源模型，通过计算文本中每个单词的可预测性对偶（logprobs）来量化用户的“机器人程度”。其核心能力在于区分人类与AI，校准后ChatGPT/Claude得分接近100%，而有趣的人类回复得分通常在10-30%之间。用户无需注册即可免费体验并分享结果。
items.summary_en: Clanker is a free, no-signup reverse Turing test that uses Llama3.1, Deepseek v3, and Qwen3 to score text predictability via logprobs. It aims to assign 100% to chatbots and 10-30% to interesting human responses. Users generate eight text completions to compare their "clankiness" against open-source models.

directions.name: LiteCut AI
directions.description: 专为独立创作者设计的低Token消耗自动化视频剪辑代理，支持智能去冗、字幕嵌入与色彩分级。
directions.description_en: An automated video editing agent designed for indie creators with low token consumption, featuring smart filler removal, subtitle embedding, and color grading.
directions.target_user: YouTube/TikTok 内容创作者、播客主
core_features: 基于 ElevenLabs Scribe 的低成本转录与脚本分析
自动切除填充词与无意义片段
Self-evaluation 循环确保剪辑质量与合规性
core_features_en: Low-cost transcription and script analysis via ElevenLabs Scribe
Automatic removal of filler words and silent segments
Self-evaluation loop to ensure editing quality and compliance
directions.why_now: GitHub Trending 显示 video-use 项目因极低的 Token 消耗（仅 12KB 文本加少量图片）而获得高分评价（9/10）。社区热议其通过可视化合成层替代传统高成本逐帧分析的能力，证明了市场对‘轻量级、高能效’视频编辑工具的真实需求，且 Claude Code 生态的成熟使得此类 Agent 开发门槛大幅降低。
directions.why_now_en: The video-use project on GitHub Trending scored high (9/10) due to its extremely low token consumption (only 12KB text plus minimal images). Community discussions highlight its ability to replace costly traditional frame-by-frame analysis with visual synthesis layers, proving market demand for 'lightweight, high-efficiency' video editing tools, while the maturity of the Claude Code ecosystem significantly lowers the barrier to developing such Agents.
directions.monetization: SaaS 订阅制（按月/年付费，按处理时长或次数计费）
directions.monetization_en: SaaS Subscription (Monthly/Annual billing, charged per duration or usage count)

directions.name: Caveman Code Optimizer
directions.description: 一款集成于 Cursor/Claude Code 的插件，通过压缩输出语言风格显著降低开发者的 Token 成本并提升响应速度。
directions.description_en: A plugin integrated into Cursor/Claude Code that significantly reduces developers' token costs and improves response speed by compressing output language styles.
directions.target_user: 使用 Claude Code 或 Cursor 的独立开发者、小型技术团队
directions.target_user_en: Indie developers and small tech teams using Claude Code or Cursor
core_features: 实时压缩 AI 代码生成的输出语言（支持 Lite/Full/Ultra 模式）
保持 100% 技术准确性的同时减少约 75% 令牌消耗
提供 Wenyan 等特定风格模式以适配不同阅读偏好
core_features_en: Real-time compression of AI-generated code output language (supporting Lite/Full/Ultra modes)
Reduce token consumption by approx. 75% while maintaining 100% technical accuracy
Provide specific style modes like Wenyan to suit different reading preferences
directions.why_now: JuliusBrussee/caveman 项目在 GitHub Trending 上获得 8/10 的高分，社区反馈其在相同任务下比 Codex 节省约 2 倍令牌，并实现 3 倍速度提升。随着 AI 编程助手成为标配，开发者对‘降低 API 成本’和‘提高交互流畅度’的痛点日益敏感，Caveman 验证了‘语言压缩’作为独立插件市场的可行性。
directions.why_now_en: The JuliusBrussee/caveman project received a high score of 8/10 on GitHub Trending, with community feedback indicating it saves approximately 2x tokens compared to Codex under similar tasks and achieves a 3x speed increase. As AI coding assistants become standard, developers are increasingly sensitive to pain points regarding 'reducing API costs' and 'improving interaction fluency.' Caveman validates the feasibility of 'language compression' as a standalone plugin market.
directions.monetization: Freemium 模式（基础免费，高级模式如 Ultra/Wenyan 订阅付费）
directions.monetization_en: Freemium Model (Basic free, advanced modes like Ultra/Wenyan subscription-based)
